description: Rb₂Na₄Co₂O₅ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4₂/mnm space group. Rb is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one O atom. The Rb-O bond length is 2.80 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.49 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.67 Å. Co is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.82 Å) and one longer (1.94 Å) Co-O bond length. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in an octahedral geometry to two equivalent Rb, two equivalent Na, and two equivalent Co atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Co atom.
